# Shared test fixtures

JavaScript and Rust tests use these checked-in inputs without requiring the
ignored `analysis/` research directory.

- `security-selector-fixtures.json`: canonical security evidence generated by
  the optional `analysis/scripts/extract_security_selector_evidence.py` tool.
  Its source paths describe provenance; tests do not open those research files.
  It includes synthetic KDF inputs and independently checks both compiled
  security registries.
- `OpenRDX-v1-07.bin`: unchanged public firmware container used to check release
  eligibility; SHA-256
  `1e26a407d5178f1344682798b7ab935f407fe2ce160fb3d03354cf823a951a9e`.
- `native-model-contract.json`: shared deterministic native model expectations.

The receiver declaration parser lives in `scripts/receiver-model-contract.mjs`
and is shared with the optional offline review tool.
